title: Monday · Boo Bash art, maths work and SpacesEDU
arrival: Answer attendance, then hand in forms. Find your Boo Bash art and get ready to continue from where you stopped.
note: Updated to the teacher-confirmed Monday sequence: Boo Bash art in the morning, maths work after recess, and laptops for in-class SpacesEDU after quiet time. Check actual unfinished work rather than treating earlier plans as completed lessons. Use only teacher-assigned maths work and existing classroom posting instructions; this plan adds no assignment or home-upload deadline. Prepare available art materials and existing work. Use available posting scaffolds as needed in the teacher view; keep individual supports and private materials off the public hub. Preserve snack 10:20, recess 10:35–10:50, lunch 11:50–12:35, quiet time 12:35–12:50, cleanup around 2:00 and dismissal 2:35. The current regular schedule lists French on Tuesday and Friday, with no Monday specialist block. We Scare Hunger runs October 26–30; verify accepted items and collection procedures from school notices. Donations are optional, with no quota or disclosure of family circumstances. Record actual stopping points after teaching. Nevermoor and Bloxels remain ongoing; do not infer progress or add them as new tasks in this work block.

blocks.title: Arrival and attendance
studentSteps: Answer attendance, then hand in any forms.
Find your unfinished Boo Bash art and listen for the next step.
blocks.notes: Attendance before forms. Welcome students after Friday’s non-instructional day. Briefly preview the food-drive launch; follow school collection directions for any donations already arriving. Do not announce amounts or identify donors.

blocks.title: Arts · continue Boo Bash art
blocks.firstAction: Find your Boo Bash art and show where you stopped.
studentSteps: Follow the original art directions and choose one next step with your teacher.
Continue with the available materials. Use line, shape, colour or pattern on purpose.
Explain one design choice and make an improvement if it helps your idea.
Label and store your work safely before snack.
blocks.notes: Begin with the actual work already underway. Use the original Boo Bash art instructions; do not start a new project or infer that Thursday’s work is finished. Briefly model safe use of the materials and one design choice, such as how repeated zigzag lines can create energy. Allow different justified effects and the existing autumn-design alternative. Give sustained work time with short check-ins or movement as needed. If a student finishes, ask them to explain or refine an existing choice or follow another teacher-approved step. Begin storing tools and wet work before 10:20. Keep participation separate from celebrations or personal disclosures.
blocks.titleKo: 미술 · 부 배시 작품 이어 하기
blocks.firstActionKo: 하던 미술 작품을 찾아 어디까지 했는지 보여 주세요.

blocks.title: Snack
blocks.firstAction: Have your snack and tidy your space.

blocks.title: Maths work block · continue assigned work
blocks.firstAction: Open the maths work your teacher has assigned and show where you stopped.
studentSteps: Check with your teacher which unfinished step to continue.
Use the worked example or support your teacher identifies. Show your thinking as you work.
Check your work using the agreed method. Ask about the step that is confusing.
Show your teacher what you tried and mark your next step before lunch.
blocks.notes: After recess, inspect the actual assigned work and confirm each student’s next step. This is a work block, not a new list of factorization questions. Prime factorization remains ongoing: use the existing model/companion only where it supports the work already assigned. Do not infer completion or advance automatically to GCF/LCM. Offer a brief model or small-group explanation from the current task, then time to continue and check. Accept oral explanation, pointing, drawing or scribing. Use the final few minutes to review actual work and record stopping points privately. Finishing the block does not make all remaining work homework.
blocks.titleKo: 수학 활동 · 정해진 과제 이어 하기
blocks.firstActionKo: 선생님이 정해 준 수학 과제를 펴고 어디까지 했는지 보여 주세요.

blocks.title: Lunch
blocks.notes: Usual intermediate routine: outside 11:50–12:12; transition 12:12–12:13; eating 12:13–12:35.
blocks.firstAction: Follow our outside-play and lunch routine.
blocks.firstActionKo: 바깥 놀이와 점심시간에는 정해진 순서대로 하세요.

blocks.title: Quiet individual time
blocks.firstAction: Choose quiet reading, drawing or a calm seated activity.
studentSteps: At the signal, put materials away and get ready for SpacesEDU instructions.
blocks.notes: Preserve the usual quiet reset after lunch. Quiet non-reading choices are available.
blocks.firstActionKo: 조용히 책 읽기, 그림 그리기, 자리에 앉아서 쉬기 중 하나를 고르세요.

blocks.title: SpacesEDU · in-class work and posting
blocks.firstAction: Wait for your teacher’s instructions, then open your existing work.
studentSteps: Use the class sign-in instructions. Ask for help privately if access is not working.
Follow the posting directions your teacher has already given. Choose the existing work your teacher identifies.
Use the available planning page or sentence starters if helpful. Explain your learning in your own words.
Review with your teacher as directed, save your work, sign out and return equipment before cleanup.
blocks.notes: Laptops for SpacesEDU after quiet time are the teacher-confirmed plan; no cart number or reservation is invented. Confirm account access and model the existing class posting routine using a non-private example. Students work from existing tasks and posting instructions, not a newly assigned number of posts. Use available posting scaffolds or booklets where helpful; keep individual versions, private PDFs, names and support information off public/projected pages. Offer drawing, dictation or a spoken rehearsal according to the support already in place. Review the audience and selected content before sharing through the class’s agreed workflow. If access fails, prepare the same post on paper and save it for later; do not require a new account, purchase or home upload. Begin saving and returning equipment at 1:55 so cleanup starts at 2:00.
blocks.firstActionKo: 선생님 안내를 기다린 뒤 하던 과제를 여세요.

blocks.title: Planners, jobs and cleanup
blocks.notes: Restore the room at 2:00. Planner reminder: We Scare Hunger, October 26–30; follow school collection instructions if your family chooses to contribute. No donation quota or new homework deadline.
blocks.firstAction: Restore our room and record any confirmed reminders.
blocks.firstActionKo: 교실을 정리하고 확정된 안내 사항을 적으세요.

blocks.title: Community · team-captains activity
blocks.firstAction: Listen to the first step and check how everyone can join.
studentSteps: Join a familiar cooperative activity; share roles and listen.
Name one helpful action from today, or pass.
Tell or show one learning step you want to continue tomorrow.
blocks.notes: Use a familiar teacher-approved cooperative game with a brief captain demonstration. Check access and shared turns, without public rankings. Finish with an appreciation and a next-learning step. Record what actually happened in art, maths and SpacesEDU for the next plan.
blocks.firstActionKo: 첫 번째 안내를 듣고 모두가 참여할 수 있는지 확인하세요.

blocks.title: Pack up and dismissal
blocks.firstAction: Check your belongings and get ready for a calm departure.
blocks.firstActionKo: 자기 물건을 확인하고 차분히 하교할 준비를 하세요.

backups: If art needs more time, store it safely and record the next step; keep snack and recess on time.
If assigned maths work is unclear, ask the teacher which existing step to use. Do not invent extra questions or a homework deadline.
If SpacesEDU access or equipment is unavailable, prepare the same existing post on paper with the available scaffold and save it for a later class session.
Use confirmed We Scare Hunger dates only; follow school instructions for collection details and keep donations optional.
Keep breaks, lunch, cleanup and dismissal. Record actual progress without assuming that planned activities were completed.
